name: Air-Fryer Zucchini Coins
ingredients: 2 medium zucchini, cut in 1 cm coins
3 tbsp besan mixed with 3 tbsp water
½ tsp each garlic powder, paprika and oregano
Dip: ½ cup plain low-fat yogurt with garlic and mint
steps: Season the zucchini coins with salt and let them sit for 5 minutes; pat dry.
Dip in the besan batter, then in the mixed breadcrumbs, nutritional yeast and spices.
Preheat the air fryer to 190°C and spray the basket.
Cook in a single layer for 10–12 minutes, turning halfway, until golden.
note: Low-carbohydrate; the yogurt dip adds protein.
